blocks.content: The unit was received at the workshop for detailed inspection, fault assessment and complete servicing. [Describe the reported fault.]

The unit was subjected to a detailed visual and electrical inspection to identify the source of the fault.

  • Removed the required covers and protective assemblies.
  • Inspected the affected board for visible damage and component condition.
  • Performed component-level inspection and testing of the affected circuit.
  • Checked the condition of the power and passive components on all PCB boards.
  • Inspected all PCB assemblies, connectors, and solder joints for signs of overheating, contamination, and component ageing.

• [Finding 1]
  • [Finding 2]
  • Passive components on the remaining PCB boards are recommended for replacement as preventive maintenance.

• [Replace faulty component(s)]
  • Carry out complete servicing of all PCB boards, including cleaning, inspection, testing, and rework as required.
  • Replace weak and ageing passive components on all PCB boards as part of preventive maintenance.
  • Remove the old thermal compound and reapply fresh heat sink paste on the power modules.
  • Perform a complete operational test before returning the unit to service.
[Summary of fault, repair scope and expected outcome.]
